commands: sh -c '_out=$(lslpp -i) || exit $?; printf "%s\n" "$_out" |grep -i ssh || echo "openssh.base.server not installed"'
blurb: This check verifies that AIX runs the SSH server for replay-resistant authentication to privileged and non-privileged accounts. openssh.base.server must be installed and the sshd subsystem must be active.
